what: American Express issues premium credit and charge cards and runs its own payment network, earning fees from both cardholders and merchants.
customers: Affluent consumers, small businesses and corporations, and the merchants that accept Amex.
money: fees merchants pay on Amex purchases
annual fees on Platinum, Gold and other cards
moat: A closed-loop network with premium, high-spending customers, loyal through rewards programs.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 10% last year and about 11% a year over three years
Its cardholders spend far more per card than those of any other network
Card fee revenue grows every year as it raises fees and adds premium cardholders
watch: Billed business growth and net card fee revenue.
